name: Norse Dwarf Bolt
text: Ballista ammunition. Hullbreaker inflicts +2 Damage against wooden structures and gains Damaging. No ammunition is assumed loaded.

name: Bomb (Mortar)
text: Mortar ammunition. Printed unit/bundle quantity is not explicitly specified; do not invent a bundle.

name: Incendiary (Mortar)
text: Mortar ammunition, separate from the core Incendiary weapon. Inflicts 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions. Printed unit/bundle quantity is not explicitly specified.
